gloss: extent of a rise; margin of increase

definitions.gloss: extent of a rise; size of an increase; margin of gain
definitions.explanation: How far something has gone up — a price, a stock index, a temperature — stated as the size of the movement rather than the final figure. Common in news reporting on markets and weather.

examples.japanese: {上昇幅|じょうしょうはば}が{大|おお}きい。
{株価|かぶか}の{上昇幅|じょうしょうはば}は{過去|かこ}{最大|さいだい}となった。
examples.english: The rise in the stock price was the largest on record.

examples.japanese: {午後|ごご}になって、{気温|きおん}の{上昇幅|じょうしょうはば}が{予想|よそう}より{小|ちい}さくなった。
examples.english: In the afternoon, the temperature rise turned out to be smaller than expected.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}の{値上|ねあ}げは、{上昇幅|じょうしょうはば}を{三|さん}パーセント{以内|いない}に{抑|おさ}えるという。
examples.english: They say this price increase will be held to within three percent.

notes:
{幅|はば} (width) attaches to many words of change to name the size of the movement, so this family is worth learning together.

RELATED FORMS:
- {下落幅|げらくはば}: extent of a drop — the direct opposite
- {値上|ねあ}げ{幅|はば}: size of a price increase
- {伸|の}び{幅|はば}: extent of growth

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上昇幅|じょうしょうはば}が{大|おお}きい／{小|ちい}さい: for the rise to be large / small
- {上昇幅|じょうしょうはば}を{抑|おさ}える: to hold down the size of an increase
- {上昇幅|じょうしょうはば}が{縮|ちぢ}まる: for the gain to narrow
